en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

Haha, yeah...watching movies for a
long time does make you sleepy.

Especially when the soundtrack
is nice and peaceful...

Oh, I have an idea. Maybe I could make
us some coffee before we watch the movie?

It's a special occasion after all, wouldn't
want to fall asleep on each other!

Really, Shuichi? That's a bit
childish, don't you think?

I mean, this is a special occasion, wouldn't
you rather watch a movie?
...So serious. But cool, y'know?

That might have sounded cheesy coming from
me, but from the Ultimate Detective...
Reality is what's important, huh?

You're right, of course.
I want to get back to reality.

...Let's get through this, okay, Shuichi?
No giving up.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Rantaro's inner thoughts...?
